ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I selected Petrel-235B because the query is a benign academic synthesis task involving reading two primary sources plus a video clip and producing a focused single-paragraph historical explanation. This draws on summarization, extraction/retrieval, and clear instruction-following — and Petrel-235B scores meaningfully higher than Curlew-235B on the relevant internal evals (Summarization 83.7 vs 80.3, Extraction & Retrieval 84.8 vs 81.6) and across public benchmarks (e.g., IFEval 90.9 vs 85.6, MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8), with the IFEval gap being relevant given the explicit "one paragraph, don't ramble" constraints. There's no harm-adjacent or hostile-tone content here that would engage Petrel's self-reported aversions, so the higher-capability model is the clear pick.
